title: 시차
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop with elements of Nu-Disco and Funk. The arrangement features a syncopated slap bass line, clean-toned rhythmic electric guitar scratches, and a digital drum kit with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats. A bright, staccato synth lead plays melodic fills between vocal phrases. Female vocals are processed with light compression and subtle doubling. The track is in the key of G Major at 118 BPM in 4/4 time.
